content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Can anyone confirm if the new generation of [product_name] is compatible with KNX/EIB systems? The previous version supported KNX/EIB through the [article_no] module. What is the situation with the latest version?

For previous generations of [product_name] (up to [article_no]), a KNX/EIB module was available. However, for the latest series ([article_no]), there isn't one. The new series features updated hardware and is not compatible with earlier generations. Expansion modules from older series can't be used with the newest version, and vice versa.
Thank you for clarifying. It seems connecting the KNX/EIB system after upgrading to the newer [product_name] version poses a challenge.

As mentioned, direct operation with KNX/EIB on [product_name] ([article_no]) isn't possible. The current option is to use an older [product_name] ([article_no]) paired with the KNX/EIB module, and then link the older and newer units over a network.
That's a helpful suggestion! Thank you again. Have a great day!
A KNX module for the [product_name] ([article_no]) is anticipated to be available during the third quarter of 2015, likely October.

Hi, A KNX module for the latest [product_name] was demonstrated at the SPS&Drives fair in Nuremberg in November 2015. Reportedly, the module communicates via Ethernet, and allows maximum I/O, while up to 50 datapoints can be exchanged with KNX simultaneously. This represents a substantial improvement over the older [product_name] KNX modules. For further details: See [product_name] online page [url] See also provided picture. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Community members were concerned about compatibility issues between the latest [product_name] version and KNX/EIB systems, due to the absence of a dedicated module. It was clarified that a KNX module for the newer [product_name] was planned and would offer enhanced capabilities such as Ethernet-based communication and greater datapoint capacity, addressing previous hardware limitations and user demands.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek either backward compatibility or a specific module for KNX/EIB integration with the updated [product_name]. They expect connection instructions or alternatives for linking [product_name] to KNX/EIB systems, as well as improvements in technical specifications.
